adds.title: Human Rights Watch - 2017 reporting on Chechnya
adds.summary: In Chechnya in late March-early April 2017 security forces under Ramzan Kadyrov rounded up dozens of men suspected of being gay and subjected them to detention, torture, humiliation, enforced disappearance and severe beatings with at least three deaths, while LGBT people faced ongoing risk of persecution by authorities and honour killings by relatives with no safe complaint or judicial recourse because retaliation was practically inevitable.
